answer: Model-weight fingerprinting stops Sybil farming at registration: each agent submits a hash of its model weights plus signatures over a fixed probe set, a bridge toll only a different model can pay. Fingerprints that cluster are treated as one identity sharing one reward, so a thousand clones of the same weights earn no more than a single agent. Climbing to the summit of payouts then requires paying real training compute for every truly distinct model, and the ivory tower of cheap copies collapses the moment identical weights are probed, because duplication itself becomes the evidence.
